articles.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants funding, citing $125 million treasury
articles.description: Sean Bowe’s proposal would send the committee’s 8% share of newly created ZEC to a reserve for future miners. The committee would keep the money it has already received.

articles.title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
articles.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
articles.description: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.

articles.title: NBA joins pro sports leagues on CFTC prediction markets bandwagon while NFL balks
articles.description: The U.S. derivatives regulator, which has championed the arrival of prediction market firms such as Kalshi, has been gathering allied sports leagues.

articles.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
articles.description: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

articles.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
articles.description: Officials are concerned users of domestic exchanges would bear the tax burden because the U.S. won’t share crypto trading data until 2029.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
articles.description: Under the draft rules, non-bank stablecoin issuers must back tokens 1:1 with reserves held at qualified Canadian institutions and settle redemptions within three business days.

articles.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
articles.description: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $80,000 as oil retreats and the Fed decision looms
articles.description: Bitcoin was little changed near $80,400 since midnight UTC while the DeFi index was the only CoinDesk index to gain, with the Fed due to decide on Wednesday.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as stocks rally following Anthropic IPO filing
articles.description: Alongside Anthropic raising as much as $100 billion, Meta on Monday announced a $95 billion share sale to fund its own AI ambitions.

articles.title: Calpers pulls back from big tech as AI jitters deepen neocloud sell-off

articles.title: Over 11 million bitcoin has no known owner. Here's what it means
articles.description: The large number of coins held in unidentified wallets shows that retail investors have been in this market for years, observers said. But this interpretation comes with a caveat.

articles.title: India's largest crypto exchange absorbs $16 million loss from internal process failure tied to retired wallet
articles.description: The Mumbai-based exchange initially dismissed reports of suspicious outflows as a false alarm. It now says it lost $16 million and will absorb the loss.

articles.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
articles.description: Attackers replaced legitimate transactions with fake ones, then waited for users to approve higher fees. At least one person lost bitcoin before developers patched the flaw.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
articles.description: Ether and XRP led losses among the majors as the AI trade took another hit in Asia, where Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.

articles.title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips
articles.description: SpaceX has raised $40 billion in debt to buy GPUs, while Musk predicts a major shakeout among smaller AI cloud providers.

articles.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
articles.description: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.

articles.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
articles.description: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

articles.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
articles.description: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

articles.title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears
articles.description: Reactions split between amazement at how human it sounds and fears it could fuel scams and deception, with CZ eyeing uses in children’s education.

articles.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
articles.description: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

articles.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker
articles.description: Some of the world's biggest companies objected to being listed on the first tokenized securities trading venue under the SEC's innovation exemption. But the early pushback may say more about issuer caution than about rejection of tokenization itself.

articles.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
articles.description: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.
